name: Citizenship by Marriage (Simplified Procedure)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires being the spouse of a Georgian citizen with 5 years' continuous residence in Georgia.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years' continuous residence in Georgia while married to the Georgian-citizen spouse.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires passing the same electronic language/history/law test used for standard naturalisation.
requirements.fix_path: Book and pass the language/history/law test.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 5 years' continuous residence in Georgia

sources.title: Legislative Herald of Georgia (matsne.gov.ge) -- Organic Law of Georgia on Georgian Citizenship, Article 14
Public Service Development Agency of Georgia (sda.gov.ge) -- Georgian citizenship (naturalization) service page

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Georgia's initial build. This is Article 14's simplified procedure -- half the residence requirement of standard naturalisation (5 years vs. 10) but the same language/history/law test, per matsne.gov.ge. Repatriates follow a separate special regulation per the same article, not modelled as its own route here since its terms were not detailed in the text fetched in this pass -- flagged as a scope gap, not invented.
